note: Log what changed between scenarios here. A scenario is one experimental configuration (model x task-set x harness); within a scenario, trials are independent repeats at temperature 0 and nothing changes between them. Rebuild both dashboards after editing: python tools/export_dashboard_json.py && python tools/build_dashboard.py

pairs.text: Scenario 2 swaps the subject model: qwen2.5-coder:7b-8k (larger weights, same family), on identical tasks, grader, and harness. It measures the model-scaling effect - not task or grader changes. Scenario 1 kept 3 trials per task; scenario 2 currently has the exploratory 1-trial pass.

Scenario 3 is planned, not run: a hosted frontier model (Gemini or Groq free key) on identical tasks and grader - zero local compute. Run it live from the React dashboard's '+ Run Scenario' panel; the key stays in memory only.
